description: This Python source file defines a class `ReportStorage` that implements file-based storage for validation reports within a larger project. It handles operations such as retrieving reports by request or response IDs, searching by score range, updating report statuses, managing export files, and gathering report statistics.

classes.name: ReportStorage
classes.description: A class for storing and managing validation reports using the filesystem, extending from a base storage class.

methods.name: __init__(self, storage_dir: str = "data/reports")
methods.description: Initializes the report storage, setting up directories for report data and exports.

methods.name: None _update_index_entry(self, entry: Dict[str, Any], item: ValidationReport)
methods.description: Updates a report index entry with report-specific fields such as title, request and response IDs, report type, status, overall score, total issues, and LLM provider.

methods.name: List[ValidationReport] get_by_request(self, request_id: UUID)
methods.description: Retrieves all validation reports associated with a specific request ID.

methods.name: Optional[ValidationReport] get_by_response(self, response_id: UUID)
methods.description: Retrieves a validation report associated with a specific response ID.

methods.name: List[ValidationReport] search_by_score_range(self, min_score: float, max_score: float)
methods.description: Returns all reports with an overall score within the specified range.

methods.name: List[ValidationReport] get_failed_validations(self)
methods.description: Returns reports that contain critical or error issues, indicating failed validation.

methods.name: Optional[ValidationReport] update_status(self, report_id: UUID, status: ReportStatus, file_path: Optional[str] = None, error_message: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Updates the status of a report, optionally setting a file path and error message depending on the new status.

methods.name: Path get_export_path(self, report_id: UUID, format: ReportType)
methods.description: Generates the file path for exporting a report in a specific format, including a timestamp.

methods.name: int cleanup_old_exports(self, days: int = 30)
methods.description: Removes export files older than the specified number of days from the exports directory.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_report_stats(self)
methods.description: Compiles and returns statistics across all reports, including total count, average score, total issues, and status counts.
